text:
emmalee: Quick thread 0 Acme Health wants to sign pilot this week. Need: final signer list, PO guidance, and yes/no on two security redlines (higher pilot SLA + audit).
chris_legal: I reviewed their redline. They want a 99.9% uptime during pilot and a single audit right. Both okay with tight limits. Not comfortable with unlimited audits or uncapped credits.
tara_ps: We can offer elevated uptime for the pilot only (timeboxed) and cap credits to pilot fees. Need explicit language in orderform/addendum.
devon_finance: Our standard is PO before activation. We can accept Net30 for this customer if PO covers pilot fees upfront. Need billing contact + W9 attached to PO.
emmalee: Billing contact: m.lopez@acmehealth.com. Signers: j.park@acmehealth.com (primary, Ops) and k.singh@acmehealth.com (backup, Procurement). They prefer DocuSign.
sam_onboard: Onboarding needs the signer mapping and orderform ID to pre-create routes. Send JSON mapping like {"primary":"j.park@acmehealth.com","backup":"k.singh@acmehealth.com","billing":"m.lopez@acmehealth.com"}. Route name convention: acme-pilot-<shortid>.
chris_legal: Draft SLA addendum snippet: "For the Pilot Term (30 days), Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to achieve 99.9% monthly uptime. Customer's sole remedy shall be service credits not to exceed the fees paid for the Pilot Term. Elevated SLA will automatically revert to Provider's standard SLA upon Pilot expiration unless extended in writing."
tara_ps: Add clause to orderform: pilot region = us-east-1, pilot capacity size = Dedicated-small, start/end dates explicit.
devon_finance: Agree on Net30. PO amount?
emmalee: PO will be for $42,500 (pilot + premium support).
devon_finance: OK. We will accept ACH. Bank details are provided after countersign. Please ensure PO references orderform ID and attaches W9.
docusign_bot: DocuSign envelope prepared and sent to j.park@acmehealth.com, k.singh@acmehealth.com. Envelope ID: env-0xabc123.
emmalee: Please confirm orderform ID so I can tell customer to reference it on the PO.
sam_onboard: Recommend orderform ID RF-2024-ACME-P01 to match naming.
emmalee: RF-2024-ACME-P01 confirmed. Emmalee -> asking Acme to send PO and W9 now.
chris_legal: On audit: propose "Customer may request one remote compliance review during the Pilot Term upon 30 days' notice and at Customer's expense; scope limited to systems and processes that directly process Customer Data, and performed under Provider's standard confidentiality and security procedures." Push back on quarterly or on-demand audits.
tara_ps: That matches implementation constraints. We can support remote review and provide required artifacts.
devon_finance: Checklist for countersign/invoice: 1) PO with RF-2024-ACME-P01 referenced, 2) completed W9 attached, 3) signed DocuSign envelope. Net30 begins on invoice date.
emmalee: PO and W9 sent from m.lopez@acmehealth.com, PO# ACME-PO-09124 for $42,500. Attaching now.
docusign_bot: Envelope env-0xabc123 signed by j.park@acmehealth.com at 2024-08-30T14:55:12Z.
sam_onboard: Signed envelope received. Preparing onboarding tasks. Emmalee please confirm route name and mapping format one more time.
emmalee: Route: acme-pilot-08124. Mapping: {"primary":"j.park@acmehealth.com","backup":"k.singh@acmehealth.com","billing":"m.lopez@acmehealth.com"}. Attach Orderform RF-2024-ACME-P01 to PO# ACME-PO-09124.
devon_finance: Received PO. W9 validated. We'll prepare invoice and issue it with ACH instructions after countersigned MSA is uploaded.
chris_legal: I'll countersign MSA + Pilot Addendum and upload. Once countersigned, Legal to hand to Sales for delivery.
emmalee: Great team. I'll close thread after invoice posted and account enabled. :thumbsup:
